newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia April passenger car sales 24,582 units.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia April passenger car sales 24,582 units.

text.p: Malaysia's passenger car sales, including four-wheel-drive vehicles for private use, totalled 24,582 units in April against 24,189 in April last year, the Malaysian Motor Traders Association (MMTA) said on Wednesday.
In March 1997, passenger car sales including four-wheel-drive vehicles totalled 28,290 units.
Commercial vehicle sales, including four-by-four vehicles used for business, totalled 8,835 units against 6,508 in April 1996.
In March 1997, 7,903 commercial vehicles were sold.

The locally-made Proton remained the best-selling car. Protons sold by national carmaker Proton and by Usahasama Proton-DRB totalled 15,931 units in April, against 15,829 units in the same month a year ago, and 18,590 in March 1997.
